freshness_audit.policy: Diagnostic overlay: exact path/digest dependencies become stale; unrelated evidence keeps its recorded result. Global repository drift without an attributable row reference is reported separately.

identity_binding_policy: Only current file bytes matching the recorded digest, exact fixture map+digest matching the ledger source_maps inventory, synthetic images whose digest/recipe/length/schema pin are recomputed from the report descriptor, or separately pinned row-specific binding artifacts whose exact bytes are rehashed count as bound. Historical pins with verified absence reports are listed separately and are not represented as recovered bytes.
metric_policy: Only explicit name/value/unit triples count as normalized metrics; extracted numeric tokens from report prose are not promoted.

rows.measurement_limitation: Counts are from compiler inventory and generated crosswalk; they do not imply semantic closure of unclassified ranges.
